Property tax: the rate is the vendored county rate table's entry for Maricopa, AZ — 10.2573 per $100 of assessed value, tax year 2025, Tax area code 971300 — City of Phoenix / Deer Valley Unified School District #97 — with the AZ assessment ratio and reset-on-sale rule from the same table. No county portal was reached: the parcel, the tax area code, the assessor's value, the billed amount, the bill's tax year, the exemption read MISSING. The uploaded rent roll did not state the date it was run, so the as-of date was INFERRED as 2025-11-12 — the most recent lease start or move-in on the roll, which is the earliest date the snapshot can have been taken. Every window on this page (the move-in and lease-signed lookback, and annualised turnover) is measured back from that date. It is not the upload date, and it is not today.

This output set was generated from documents uploaded to a public demo. It read an offering memorandum, a trailing-twelve statement, a rent roll. 10 summary field(s) were read from the marketing document by a language model and each one is carried with the sentence it came from; any value whose sentence could not be found in the document was discarded rather than shown. Every figure on the T-12 and rent-roll tabs are computed by code from the uploaded spreadsheets, not read by a model. Each T-12 line's category was assigned from the wording of its account label, not from an account-code table, because account codes mean different things in different systems. The category chosen for every line is shown beside it on the T-12 Data tab so you can check it; lines that could not be placed confidently are excluded rather than guessed at, and are listed above. Comparable rents, demographics, competing supply and closing costs were not run: they need data sources this demo does not reach. The uploaded files were deleted as soon as they were parsed, and this output set is deleted with the rest of the run.

summary.pricing_guidance: $215,000 per unit (entered on the upload form); the memorandum's own figure is $308,333 per unit (a stated total of $7,400,000 over 24 units, +43.4% against the price entered)
summary.tax_rate_evidence: Vendored county rate table: 10.2573 per $100 of assessed value, tax year 2025 — Tax area code 971300 — City of Phoenix / Deer Valley Unified School District #97: Primary rate 6.7007; Secondary rate 3.5566. Source: Maricopa County, '2025 Tax Rates, Maricopa County, Arizona' (the treasurer's rate table by tax area code), row 971300: primary 6.7007, approx residential primary 5.1401, secondary 3.5566 (maricopa.gov/5160/Tax-Levy-and-Rates — Tax Rate 2025 PDF). Verified 2026-09-04. The parcel's own tax district decides; this is the representative stack for the county. Maricopa publishes rates per tax area code and they vary by district: area 591300 (City of Phoenix / Laveen ESD #59) is 15.7387 in the same table. The parcel's own tax area decides. The 'approx residential primary' column is the owner-occupied rebate and does not apply to a rental. Ratio 10% — legal class 4.2, residential rental (A.R.S. sec. 42-15003 (class four assessed at 10%); A.R.S. sec. 42-12004 (class four includes residential rental property)). The upload demo reaches no county portal: the parcel, tax area code, assessor's value and billed amount are not verified against one, and read MISSING unless an uploaded document stated them. The rate on file is a representative district stack for the county, not the parcel's own.
summary.tax_basis_label: Limited property value (LPV), per the county assessor
summary.tax_basis_note: Arizona taxes the limited property value, not the price. Under Proposition 117 (Ariz. Const. art. IX sec. 18; A.R.S. sec. 42-13301) the LPV rises at most 5% a year and does not reset on sale, so a buyer inherits the seller's basis and tax priced off the purchase price overstates the bill — roughly threefold on the showcase parcel. With no assessor value on file, no year-one estimate is asserted. The rate table's 'approx residential primary' column is the class-3 owner-occupied rebate (A.R.S. sec. 15-972) and does not apply to a rental; the full primary plus secondary rate is the one billed.
summary.tax_per_unit_flag: OUTSIDE the band (the statement's line per unit): $4,441 per unit a year is outside the AZ band of $400–$2,600 — double-check the rate, its unit and the assessment ratio against the bill or the statement. The band is a typical range, not a rule: a new-build can sit above it.
